cases.delta: Native v1 signed descriptor (v/update_id/app_version/target/host_abi/script_abi/archive_sha256/entries/native_executable/native_build_id) with a detached Ed25519 signature over the exact descriptor bytes and a SHA-256 of the whole payload ZIP. Pending is ONE atomically published STORE envelope 'src.zip' holding exactly info.json (the signed bytes), info.sig and payload.zip (the original archive). This is an explicit format migration, not the Python source-injection archive: the reference prefix rules are preserved and compared explicitly (only members under 'xeHentai-<update_id>/' that the signed descriptor lists are materialized; directories and foreign entries are dropped), but entries are named install-relative with signed lengths and the format is not byte-compared to the Python code zip. Reading uses zip's enclosed_name plus real copy counts, and rejects traversal, absolute/backslash-ambiguous names, duplicates, symlinks, reserved user-state paths and archive expansion. Where Python accepted v=999 and kept unusable packages, the native format rejects ABI/target/version mismatches and retires rejected candidates.

cases.source: approved security hardening: M5 FD product read boundary (task-root FD authority)
inputs: gallery request task-outside (title probe-outside): entry 1.jpg is a symlink to {root}/outside/absent.jpg, a literal outside the gallery whose referent does not exist; the sibling probe-outside.zip carries entry 1.jpg = ZIP-OUTSIDE-ENTRY-BYTES
read get_image_path(guid=task-outside, fid=1) against the real App/Task fixture under each side's own work root
observed oracle round-1 and round-2: status 200, mime image/jpeg, bytes ZIP-OUTSIDE-ENTRY-BYTES (reference follow-open reports the outside referent absent and serves the sibling ZIP entry)
observed candidate round-1 and round-2: status 404, no bytes and no ZIP fallback (the outside literal is denied before any lookup or fallback)
observed poststate before/after in both rounds: task states/metadata, session has_login, queue order, cookies, headers, login cookie header and the normalized disk tree are unchanged by the denial
assertions: a mapped gallery leaf that links to a literal path outside the gallery is denied before any lookup or fallback, even when the outside referent does not exist
expected outcome: HTTP 404 with an empty body, zero sibling-ZIP fallback, zero outside payload opens
expected poststate: the outside referent is untouched, the gallery and the sibling archive are unchanged, and a fresh unrelated request still serves its exact bytes
the pinned reference resolves the leaf with os.path.join/open, so its follow-open reports the outside referent as absent and it serves the matching sibling ZIP entry
cases.delta: the reference may serve the matching sibling ZIP entry for an outside dangling link; the product denies instead. No blanket alias change: internal dangling links keep the reference ZIP fallback and legal internal relative/absolute aliases still serve their exact bytes

oracle.python: CPython 3.14.7 from the lease toolchain with the preinstalled requests package; isolated cwd/HOME/TMP per invocation, no network, no real accounts or cookies
environment_simulations: uuid.uuid4 frozen to a scripted sequence; throwaway draws during session load are unobservable
temporary roots normalized to <ROOT> in observations
directory listing order normalized for file trees; set-valued duplicate_map copies sorted
zip timestamps ignored; entry order, compression, sizes, contents and comment compared

notes: Status implemented/delta means two fresh rounds produced passing evidence.
The en_us-only key z_test_fallback_probe is test-only and is excluded from key-set equality.
Rust make_ua intentionally reproduces the reference implicit None return.

config.rss.deny-* run under the pinned runtime feature set: the http-client feature is off, so the network case proves refusal plus zero loopback contacts rather than a formerly reachable network path; process and file writes are proven reachable under the pre-fix binding by a driven-SDK spike recorded in evidence-r1.
M2 task-api/session/files suites run the real reference App/Task in an isolated cwd and compare full task/app observations.
Session migration starts from an h.json written by the reference and is loaded independently by both implementations.

Session directory fixtures (history, updated, multi, subdir, external and isolation) are written by the reference App into each side's own work root and then loaded independently by the candidate; the candidate never writes those h.json files.
An external absolute task directory is authorized only by an explicit config/startup choice; a per-task grant from a previous run is not persisted and an h.json value cannot extend the trusted roots.
Safety deltas (atomic session writes, symlink/empty-title refusal, self-duplicate lock release) are checked asymmetrically and listed per case.
App::update_config is the internal snapshot-test entry; it is not the public RPC updateConfig, and it refuses proxy/RPC side effects instead of faking them.
